verdict.rationale: Data region or residency selection is a fair question for a cloud data platform, but nothing in the evidence pack documents choosing a storage region or residency. The nearby items are about other things: compliance attestations (SOC 2), querying data where it already lives, and a community note about cloud-provider matching for external volumes.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
